title: Nonnegativity of truncated expected hitting time
statement: Let $G$ be a finite $D$-regular multigraph with $D>0$, and let $t,s$ be vertices. For each $j$, let $q_j(t,s)$ be the probability that a walk starting at $s$, choosing each of its $j$ steps uniformly from the $D$ indexed neighbors, avoids $t$ at every visited vertex, including its endpoint. For every integer $N\ge 0$, the sum $\sum_{j=0}^{N-1}q_j(t,s)$ is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a finite regular multigraph of degree $D$
